correctness.rationale: A 23-word witness has 64 output incidence counts at most three, independently enumerated from all 28 six-position choices. For the upper bound, a nonnegative 64-weight integer dual and two source weights establish 135|C|≤3246. A 48-support rational feasible LP point with denominator 35865 exactly attains the dual value 1082/45, verifying the fractional-integral gap. Exact slack identity at |C|=24 yields defect six, both constants forced, 54 slack-zero candidates and 113 positive-slack subsets. The provided C++17 exact branch verifier exhausts all 113 with 30,578 nodes, testing forced positive-weight output saturation and all 64 caps; it returns no 24-word set. Search cutoff is not hit. Exhaustive finite algorithm, not asymptotic extrapolation.
